correctness.rationale: Every 3-subset of Z7 has full translation orbit, five orbits of seven vertices. A simplex invariant under translation must be union of complete orbits. The orbits represented by 012,014,024 each contain disjoint translated triples, while 013 and 015 are cyclic Fano designs with all within-orbit triples intersecting; a cross-orbit disjoint pair excludes their union. In each invariant simplex, translation invariance forces equal barycentric coordinates, so precisely two fixed barycenters. The order-six multiplier group permutes these two orbits: 2 preserves, 3 exchanges; squares fix and nonsquares exchange, giving the quadratic sign on reduced H0. Independently enumerated 35 triples, all five orbits and all 42 affine actions; the proof itself is exhaustive finite combinatorics.
residual_risks: Fully finite orbit calculation: exhaustive argument and 35-triple enumeration; no infinite extrapolation.
